data.title: 阿尔法 · 暮色落地窗前的商会部署
data.description: 四越商会顶层密室内夕阳漫卷。阿尔法站在全景落地窗前，单手翻阅着刚封蜡的密信卷宗，另一只手优雅整理西装领口，夕阳余晖为她从容的面容镀上一层冷峻的金辉。
data.location: opulent executive corner office with high ceilings and arched panoramic windows overlooking a sprawling fantasy capital
data.action: standing gracefully by the panoramic window, holding a leather-bound folder in one hand while lightly adjusting her collar with the other, looking calmly forward
data.lighting: dramatic amber sunset streaming across polished mahogany parquet and dark fabric
data.mood: tactical supremacy, commanding executive majesty, quiet evening focus
data.promptProse: In a grand high-rise corner office bathed in sunset glow, Alpha in a dark business suit holds leather dossiers, her expression calm and sharp.
data.animaCaption: Reviewing documents by the high-rise panoramic window, golden-hour light casts warm reflections across the desk.
